title: Wizard Input Prediction and Assessment Matrix
goal: Make the mission wizard proveably correct for every assessment type, depth, prerequisite, authorization, and target-shape combination.
scope: Create and enforce a wizard matrix that covers all visible assessment tiles, multi-select behavior, target fields, access/prerequisite selections, depth selections, authorization confirmation, and launch-to-Mission-Control transition. The wizard must predict the exact chain/profile, phases, tools, prerequisites, and expected outcomes before launch.
generation_reason: The operator repeatedly found wizard regressions: cards that could not be selected, wrong mission launched, confusing phase selection, unclear prerequisites, and launch controls that did not reliably open Mission Control. Existing wizard tests are broad but not matrix-driven across all visible choices.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Wizard correctness only. Do not change runner internals or broaden scan scope. Do not bypass ROE, approval, deployment, or runtime binding.

success_criteria: Every visible wizard tile can be selected and deselected where intended.
Multi-select behavior matches the design language and creates one coherent mission plan.
Target input validation gives examples and predicted interpretation before launch.
Access/prerequisite selections explain which phases/tools they unlock and which remain blocked.
Full/Deep LAN and IoT modes preview all planned phases and conditional runners honestly.
Launch creates the expected run/chain and the Mission Control button always opens the selected run.
must_not_touch: runner internals unless a broken launch contract blocks validation
out_of_scope: Live target execution beyond safe fixtures

required_checks: Wizard matrix unit tests for tile/depth/access/target combinations
Playwright launch-flow tests for every assessment family using safe fixtures or dispatch-disabled proof
acceptance_criteria: A generated wizard matrix artifact shows expected profile/chain/phases/tools for every visible combination and the implemented UI matches it.

before_promotion: backlog-150 has completed or been explicitly deferred by the operator.
after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
